Supreme Court hears Noida DM's plea, reserves order

The Supreme Court heard a plea by Noida District Magistrate (DM) Medha Roopam challenging an Allahabad High Court order. During the hearing, the audio feed was muted. The Allahabad High Court had ordered the recovery of ₹5 lakh from Medha Roopam's salary. This order was related to the arrest of a Delhi University student under the National Security Act (NSA) during a Noida labor protest.
